perItemFindings.label: S2
perItemFindings.one_line: `AdaptiveExperiment.HasOverlap` requires bounds for every `t` and every `ω`, while core Saco Assumption 3.8 requires them only almost surely; calling it verbatim strengthens the class.

perItemFindings.label: thm:basin-stable-ipwz
perItemFindings.one_line: `Tendsto_dist.congr_ae` needs eventual exact a.e. equality, but the stated linearization remainder is only `O_P(e_T)`, not a.e. zero.

perItemFindings.label: thm:uniform-realized-qv-pivot
perItemFindings.one_line: The planned `congr_ae` transfer cannot absorb the displayed `o_P(1)`/`O_P(T^{-1/2})` pivot remainder; its premise is eventual a.e. equality.

perItemFindings.label: prop:endogenous-qv-self-normalization-obstruction
perItemFindings.one_line: The feasible-pivot difference converges only in probability to zero, so `Tendsto_dist.congr_ae` is not applicable to this transfer.
